Vendored Windows Needle engine
==============================

libneedle.dll is the native Windows runtime used by the bundled Cactus Needle/Whistle models.
It is included so the Grain release is offline and reproducible; the application never downloads
it at runtime.

This binary came from the recovered Grain Windows distribution and is redistributed under the
Apache License 2.0 applicable to the Cactus Compute Needle runtime. The release also includes the
Cactus/Needle licence text in the generated third-party notices.
